question: Vietnam released economic reformation policy named 'Doi Moi' from 1986 to 2000. Evaluate the effectiveness of the policy based on the gini score trend of the country in 2 phases: Before 1986 and after 1986
query: SELECT year, gini_reported FROM country_income WHERE iso = 'VNM' AND (year <= 1985 OR year > 2000) ORDER BY CASE WHEN year <= 1985 THEN year ELSE NULL END ASC LIMIT 50;  This query selects the columns for `year` and `gini_reported`, filtering records where Vietnam's ISO code (`iso`) is 'VNM', representing pre-Doi Moi period up until 1985, as well as data post-2000. The results are ordered by year to analyze the gini score trend before and after policy implementation separately within a limit of 50 rows for brevity in examination.
